about_the_game:
In this rain-drenched, cozy pixel art adventure, you step into the paws of Luna, an anthropomorphic cat living in the coastal town of Northgate. You work as a botanist with a rare gift for caring for delicate orchids. In your spare time, you look for clues to a past you cannot remember.

Fifteen years ago, you were found lost and adrift in a small boat with no memory, clutching a small amulet. Somehow, your whiskers tell you that today you’ll uncover the first clue that could unravel the mystery of who you are, and what was lost.

Leave your world behind and curl up with

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Wander rain-soaked, hand-crafted pixel art islands, hearing the storm's howl above and every splashy step below. Or tune in to cozy lo-fi beats as you journey.

  • Rediscovered Memories: Find notes, treasured items and hidden memories that could restore missing pieces of your past.

  • Cherished Past: Choose which memories to treasure; each choice gently shifts your perspective and forms the path ahead.

  • Restored Trust: Rebuild shelters, rekindle bonds, and bring hope back to a community left fractured by the past.

  • Personal Endings: What you hold most dear changes conversations and outcomes along the way.

  • Kindred Spirits: Meet characters whose stories and connections stretch beyond a single lifetime or physical body.

Explore, reflect, and cherish. What will you make of your past?
